ACKS-LIB.Title: ACKS II — Library
ACKS-LIB.settings.sheetTheme.name: Character-sheet theme
ACKS-LIB.settings.sheetTheme.hint: Style the ACKS windows like the printed ACKS II character sheet: burgundy banners with small-caps lettering, gray sheet, white boxed fields. Per player.
ACKS-LIB.mount.notOwner: You need ownership of both the rider and the mount.
ACKS-LIB.mount.notMountable: {name} is not marked as mountable — allowed anyway, but check with your Judge.
ACKS-LIB.group.dropFirstStack: Drop a monster, character, or animal actor here to add the first stack — what these bodies are a copy of.
ACKS-LIB.group.dropAnotherStack: Drop another actor to add a stack (e.g. 10 spearmen beside 10 swordsmen); drop onto a stack to re-point it.
ACKS-LIB.group.pristineHint: Living bodies that have no record yet — they gain one the moment they are deployed, wounded, or named.
ACKS-LIB.group.warn.invariant: This group has more living records than its headcount — a hand-edit left it inconsistent. Raise the living count or remove records.
ACKS-LIB.group.warn.noScene: Open a scene to deploy onto.
ACKS-LIB.group.warn.noPristine: Every living member is already individuated.
ACKS-LIB.group.warn.noBodies: No living bodies left to lose.
ACKS-LIB.group.warn.badPrototype: A group's prototype must be an ordinary actor, not another group.
ACKS-LIB.group.info.detached: {name} left the group as a standalone actor.
ACKS-LIB.template.dropBase: Drop an actor here to modify it (e.g. a vampire's victim). Leave empty to generate from scratch.
ACKS-LIB.template.menuNote: {n} special abilities on the menu; budget from the {axis} choice. Rolled on Generate.
ACKS-LIB.template.stubNote: This template has no materialized tables yet — import it from a connected book first.
ACKS-LIB.template.warn.stub: This template is a stub: connect the book and re-import before generating.
ACKS-LIB.template.warn.rejected: The system rejected the generated actor (see console).
ACKS-LIB.template.captureHint: Drop an actor on this row to capture it as this option.
ACKS-LIB.template.warn.dupKey: That name is already used here.
ACKS-LIB.followerCard.noFullSheet: No full sheet is registered for this actor type.
ACKS-LIB.followerCard.acReset: Reset AC to its computed value
